sn45.36:1.2: “Bhikkhus, I will teach you asceticism and the goal of asceticism.
sn45.36:1.5: It is this Noble Eightfold Path; that is,
sn45.36:1.8: “And what, bhikkhus, is the goal of asceticism?
sn45.36:1.9: The destruction of lust, the destruction of hatred, the destruction of delusion.
sn45.36:1.10: This is called the goal of asceticism.”
